acceptanceCriteria: An it_behaves_like group whose shared example is defined in the repo attributes its assertions to the including group (test)
An unresolved shared example still reports SHARED-EXAMPLE-ONLY
A TSA requirement is added; focused testsource tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1798 (PR #1150 head 06c8d16cf, TSA-V0-062..072). A group that includes a shared example (it_behaves_like, include_examples) is not resolved, so an assertion that runs through it is flagged SHARED-EXAMPLE-ONLY. The spec lists this as a non-goal. Expected: the assertion is attributed to the including group when the shared example is defined in the same repository.
title: RSpec hygiene: assertions in a shared example are flagged SHARED-EXAMPLE-ONLY instead of being attributed to the including group
